task.description:
WF-03 Step 2b: Validate Fix Design (HARD GATE)

Validate src/design/definition-leak-fix.md for ISS-0601-LEAK-001.

This is a Type E prose design. Run validation checks:
1. Run: python tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/definition-leak-fix.md
   Must exit 0 with no BLOCKER/MAJOR findings
2. Verify design covers all issue acceptance criteria from GitHub #406:
   - Design explains how parseGraphJson allocations will be freed
   - Design identifies Definition.deinit() as the cleanup mechanism
   - Design lists call sites that need defer statements
   - Design addresses test verification strategy
3. Check: no implementation code present (pure prose only)
4. Check: all public interfaces documented (Definition.deinit signature)
5. Check: error handling strategy documented (deinit is infallible)
6. Check: migration impact documented (100+ call sites)

This is a HARD GATE. FAIL if any check fails.
Return PASS only if design is complete and implementation-ready.

On PASS: set next_action to Route to BACKEND-DEV Step 3
On FAIL: list all blocking issues for rework.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers all GitHub #406 acceptance criteria

result.summary: Design validation PASSED after rework. All 6 checks passed: lint exits 0, all GitHub #406 acceptance criteria covered, no implementation code present, all public interfaces documented, error taxonomy documented (deinit is infallible), migration impact fully documented with 9 confirmed leaking sites listed plus grep pattern for audit. Design is complete and implementation-ready.
